rules.title: Protect wood and wood-based products against decay at moisture-prone locations
rules.intent: Prevent biological decay of structural wood members by requiring naturally durable or preservative-treated wood at locations near grade, masonry/concrete contact, and exterior weather exposure.

requires.ground_contact_requirement: approved pressure-preservative-treated wood suitable for ground contact use where embedded in concrete in direct contact with ground or in concrete exposed to weather supporting permanent occupiable structures (R317.1.2)
requires.field_treatment: field-cut ends, notches, and drilled holes treated per AWPA M4 (R317.1.1)
requires.ventilation_under_balconies: net-free cross-ventilation area not less than 1/150 of separate space area (R317.1.3)

fasteners_and_connectors.general: for preservative-treated wood: hot-dipped zinc-coated galvanized steel, stainless steel, silicon bronze, or copper; staples must be stainless steel (R317.3.1)
fasteners_and_connectors.connector_coatings_default: ASTM A653 G185 zinc-coated galvanized steel or equivalent absent manufacturer recommendation

evidence_required: Lumber/plywood quality marks identifying treating plant, preservative type, retention, end use, treating standard, and inspection agency (R317.2.1)
Foundation/sill plate cut sheets or invoices showing pressure-preservative treatment per AWPA U1
Plan details and sections showing required clearances (8 in / 12 in / 18 in / 6 in / 2 in) from grade or impervious moisture barriers under sills/sleepers
Fastener/connector spec sheets demonstrating compliance with ASTM A153, A653 G185, B695, or F1667 as applicable
Field-treatment specification note referencing AWPA M4 for cut ends and holes

rules.title: Provide subterranean termite protection in termite-prone areas
rules.intent: Prevent termite damage to structural wood members in regions where Table R301.2 indicates termite hazard, by requiring chemical, physical, or material-based protection.

requires.chemical_treatment_constraint: concentration, application rate, and method strictly per termiticide label (R318.2)
requires.shield_constraint: shields placed on top of exterior foundation wall only allowed in combination with another method (R318.3)
requires.foam_plastic_constraint_in_very_heavy_te: extruded/expanded polystyrene, polyisocyanurate, and other foam plastics shall not be installed on exterior face or under interior or exterior foundation walls or slab foundations located below grade; above-grade foam shall maintain >=6 in clearance from exposed earth (R318.4)

evidence_required: Plan note specifying which of the six termite-protection methods is being used (R318.1)
Termiticide product label, applicator certification, and treatment record where chemical treatment is used
Quality marks on pressure-preservative-treated lumber/plywood (R318.1.1) and field-treatment note for cut ends (R318.1.2 / AWPA M4)
Detail showing physical barrier installation (sheeting/collars) at penetrations and foundation interface
Where in 'very heavy' termite probability area: detail showing no foam plastic below grade or approved alternative protection per R318.4 exceptions

rules.title: Anchor wood sill/sole plates to continuous foundations with minimum bolt size, spacing, embedment, and edge distance
rules.intent: Provide a positive load path from wood-framed walls to the foundation to resist lateral and uplift forces and prevent sill displacement.

requires.decay_and_termite_protection: sill and sole plates protected per Sections R317 and R318 where required
requires.concrete_consolidation: where anchor bolts impede consolidation, concrete shall be vibrated to ensure full contact
requires.alternates_allowed: approved anchors or anchor straps spaced to provide equivalent anchorage to 1/2-inch anchor bolts

evidence_required: Foundation plan showing anchor bolt diameter (>=1/2 in), spacing (<=6 ft o.c.), embedment (>=7 in), and middle-third location
Detail showing two-bolt minimum per plate section with one bolt within 12 in (and >=7 bolt diameters) of each end
Schedule of nuts and 3x3 plate washers at all anchor bolts within braced wall lines (per R403.1.6.1 in SDC C/D0/D1/D2)
Manufacturer cut sheet for any approved anchor straps used as equivalents
Note specifying decay/termite protection of sill and sole plates per R317 and R318

rules.title: Augment foundation anchorage in Seismic Design Categories C, D0, D1, D2
rules.intent: Improve sill-to-foundation force transfer in higher seismic regions through plate washers, denser bolt spacing at interior braced/bearing walls, and tighter spacing for taller buildings.

requires.plate_washers: R602.11.1 plate washers on every anchor bolt along the full length of required braced wall lines unless approved anchor straps are used; ordinary cut washers of adequate size are acceptable in wall lines with no braced wall panels
requires.wood_foundations_force_transfer: where continuous wood foundations per Section R404.2 are used, force transfer capacity >= connections required by Section R602.11.1, or braced wall panel connected to wood foundations per braced wall panel-to-floor fastening requirements of Table R602.3(1)

evidence_required: Seismic Design Category determination from R301.2.2 referenced on the plans
Anchor bolt schedule showing 4 ft o.c. maximum where building is over two stories
Detail showing plate washers (per R602.11.1) at all anchor bolts within braced wall lines
Interior braced/bearing wall anchorage plan showing 6 ft o.c. max spacing and bolts within 12 in of plate ends
Where wood foundations are used: hold-down/connection calculation showing force transfer capacity matches R602.11.1 or braced-wall-panel-to-floor fastening per Table R602.3(1)

rules.title: Construct wood foundation walls per identification, sizing, backfill, drainage, and fastening requirements
rules.intent: Ensure wood foundation walls have verified structural-grade lumber, adequate stud sizing for soil pressure, controlled backfill height, proper drainage/dampproofing, and fastening matching engineered details.

requires.identification: load-bearing lumber identified by grade mark of accredited lumber grading or inspection agency complying with DOC PS 20, or accept certificate of inspection in lieu of grade mark; wood structural panels conform to DOC PS 1 or DOC PS 2 with grade mark or certificate (R404.2.1)
requires.backfilling_sequence: backfill wood foundation walls only after the basement and first floors are built or the walls are braced; in crawl spaces, place interior backfill or bracing before any exterior backfill (R404.2.4)
requires.drainage_and_dampproofing: drained and dampproofed per Sections R405 and R406 (R404.2.5)
requires.fastening: wood structural panel foundation wall sheathing attached to framing per Table R602.3(1) and Section R402.1.1 (R404.2.6)

evidence_required: Lumber grade marks (or certificates of inspection) on load-bearing lumber and DOC PS 1/PS 2 marks on plywood
Stud schedule showing 2x6 members with Fb >= 1,250 psi (16 in o.c.) or Fb >= 875 psi (12 in o.c.)
Cross-section showing backfill height <=4 ft (or AWC PWF design) and plywood thickness per Table R404.2.3 where fill >12 in above interior grade
Construction sequence note prohibiting backfill until floor diaphragms or temporary bracing in place
Drainage and dampproofing details referencing R405 and R406; sheathing nailing schedule per Table R602.3(1)

rules.title: Provide minimum 2x4 wood sill plates and anchor per R403.1.6 and R602.11
rules.intent: Establish minimum sill-plate dimension and ensure sill anchorage rules govern attachment to the foundation.
evidence_required: Sill plate schedule on plans calling out >=2x4 nominal lumber
Anchor bolt/strap detail referencing R403.1.6 (and R403.1.6.1 in SDC C/D0/D1/D2)
Cross-reference to R602.11 cripple wall/braced wall panel anchorage requirements
Decay/termite protection note for sill plates per R317 and R318

rules.title: Design and construct floors per Chapter 5, Figure R502.2, R317/R318, or ANSI AWC NDS
rules.intent: Ensure wood floor systems are designed and built using the prescriptive rules of Chapter 5 (with required decay/termite protection) or under engineered design per ANSI AWC NDS.

blocking_and_subflooring.subflooring_min: utility grade lumber, No. 4 common boards, or wood structural panels per R503.2

evidence_required: Floor framing plan referencing Tables R502.3.1(1)/(2) or stamped engineering per ANSI AWC NDS
Section showing floor construction matching Figure R502.2 (sill, anchor bolts, joists, blocking, subfloor)
Decay/termite protection notes per R317 and R318 at sills and joist bearings near grade
Subfloor and blocking grade specifications per R502.2.2 and R503.2

rules.title: Provide a continuous lateral load path between floor framing and braced wall panels above and below
rules.intent: Ensure lateral seismic and wind forces are transferred between braced wall panels and the floor diaphragm without interruption.

requires.must_provide: load path for lateral forces between floor framing and braced wall panels located above or below the floor

evidence_required: Braced wall line plan identifying braced wall panels at each story
Section/detail showing connection of braced wall panel to floor framing (top and bottom plates, anchorage, blocking) per R602.10.8
Fastening schedule at rim joist/sill demonstrating continuous load path
Hold-down or strap details where required by R602.10.8

rules.title: Provide minimum bearing length and sill-plate area for joists, beams, and girders
rules.intent: Ensure adequate bearing area at joist/beam/girder ends to prevent crushing of supports and provide stable load transfer to walls and foundations.

lap_at_bearing_support.fastening: minimum three 10d face nails, or wood/metal splice with strength >= nailed lap (R502.6.1)

requires.framing_into_side_of_wood_girder: supported by approved framing anchors or on ledger strips not less than nominal 2x2 (R502.6.2)

evidence_required: Floor framing plan/section showing >=1.5 in bearing on wood or metal supports and >=3 in bearing on masonry/concrete
Sill plate detail showing >=2 in nominal thickness and >=48 sq in bearing area where joists/beams/girders bear on masonry or concrete
Lap detail showing 3 in minimum lap with three 10d face nails, or approved metal splice
Joist hanger or framing-anchor schedule with manufacturer/model and ICC-ES report numbers
Detail of ledger strip (>=2x2 nominal) where joists frame into side of wood girder
